care_actions_medication_fields_check.name: care_actions_medication_fields_check
care_actions_medication_fields_check.value: "care_actions"."action_type" <> 'medication' or ("care_actions"."medication_name" is not null and "care_actions"."medication_dose" > 0 and "care_actions"."medication_dose_unit" is not null)

care_events_manual_actor_required.name: care_events_manual_actor_required
care_events_manual_actor_required.value: "care_events"."source"::text not in ('manual', 'voice') or ("care_events"."actor_user_id" is not null and "care_events"."actor_membership_id" is not null and "care_events"."client_request_id" is not null)

care_handoff_checkpoints_manual_actor_re.name: care_handoff_checkpoints_manual_actor_required
care_handoff_checkpoints_manual_actor_re.value: "care_handoff_checkpoints"."source"::text not in ('manual', 'voice') or ("care_handoff_checkpoints"."actor_user_id" is not null and "care_handoff_checkpoints"."actor_membership_id" is not null and "care_handoff_checkpoints"."client_request_id" is not null)

feeding_components_shape_check.name: feeding_components_shape_check
feeding_components_shape_check.value:
(
        ("feeding_components"."component_type" = 'direct_breastfeeding' and "feeding_components"."duration_minutes" > 0 and "feeding_components"."amount_ml" is null and "feeding_components"."liquid_type" is null and "feeding_components"."bottle_capacity_ml" is null)
        or
        ("feeding_components"."component_type" = 'bottle' and "feeding_components"."amount_ml" > 0 and "feeding_components"."liquid_type" is not null and "feeding_components"."duration_minutes" is null and ("feeding_components"."bottle_capacity_ml" is null or "feeding_components"."bottle_capacity_ml" > 0))
      )

voice_care_devices_status_shape.name: voice_care_devices_status_shape
voice_care_devices_status_shape.value: ("voice_care_devices"."status" = 'active' and "voice_care_devices"."revoked_at" is null) or ("voice_care_devices"."status" = 'revoked' and "voice_care_devices"."revoked_at" is not null)

voice_care_feeding_sessions_timestamp_or.name: voice_care_feeding_sessions_timestamp_order
voice_care_feeding_sessions_timestamp_or.value: ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."ended_at" is null or "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."ended_at" >= "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."started_at") and ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."confirmed_at" is null or ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."ended_at" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."confirmed_at" >= "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."ended_at")) and ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."cancelled_at" is null or "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."cancelled_at" >= "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."started_at")

voice_care_feeding_sessions_state_shape.name: voice_care_feeding_sessions_state_shape
voice_care_feeding_sessions_state_shape.value:
(
        ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."state" = 'pending' and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."proposal_digest" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."final_care_event_id" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."ended_at" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."confirmed_at" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."state" = 'needs_confirmation' and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."proposal_digest" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."final_care_event_id" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."ended_at" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."confirmed_at" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."state" = 'needs_review' and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."final_care_event_id" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."confirmed_at" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."state" = 'cancelled' and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."final_care_event_id" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."confirmed_at" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."cancelled_at" is not null)
        or ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."state" = 'committing' and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."proposal_digest" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."final_care_event_id" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."ended_at" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."confirmed_at" is null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("voice_care_feeding_sessions"."state" = 'committed' and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."proposal_digest" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."final_care_event_id" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."ended_at" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."confirmed_at" is not null and "voice_care_feeding_sessions"."cancelled_at" is null)
      )

voice_care_pairing_challenges_consumptio.name: voice_care_pairing_challenges_consumption_shape
voice_care_pairing_challenges_consumptio.value: ("voice_care_pairing_challenges"."consumed_at" is null and "voice_care_pairing_challenges"."consumed_by_device_id" is null) or ("voice_care_pairing_challenges"."consumed_at" between "voice_care_pairing_challenges"."created_at" and "voice_care_pairing_challenges"."expires_at" and "voice_care_pairing_challenges"."consumed_by_device_id" is not null)
